title: Add Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite GA support
body:
### Description

Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite went GA on July 22, 2025 - https://developers.googleblog.com/en/gemini-25-flash-lite-is-now-stable-and-generally-available/ .

It would be good to make this model available to consumers of the API.

### AI SDK Version

_No response_

## Background

Google just released Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite as a GAd model, which adds a new model id.

## Summary

Added the model id for Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite GA as an allowed value in the GoogleGenerativeAIModelIds .  Updated the table in the documentation to include this model id.

## Verification

I did not manually verify.

## Tasks

- [ ] Tests have been added / updated (for bug fixes / features)
- [X] Documentation has been added / updated (for bug fixes / features)
- [X] A _patch_ changeset for relevant packages has been added (for bug fixes / features - run `pnpm changeset` in the project root)
- [X] Formatting issues have been fixed (run `pnpm prettier-fix` in the project root)

I'm unclear if any tests are required for this update.  Happy to add tests with a little guidance if needed.

Fixes #7486
